test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_replacing_insert_json_src (id UInt64, j JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 16)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE t_replacing_insert_json_unique (id UInt64, j JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 16)) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE t_replacing_insert_json_duplicate (id UInt64, j JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 16)) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_replacing_insert_json_src SELECT number, if(number < 16, concat('{"rare_', toString(number), '":', toString(number), '}'), concat('{', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(k -> concat('"field_', toString(k), '":', toString(number + k)), range(60)), ','), '}')) FROM numbers(50000)
test.query: INSERT INTO t_replacing_insert_json_unique SELECT id, j FROM t_replacing_insert_json_src
INSERT INTO t_replacing_insert_json_duplicate SELECT id % 45000, j FROM t_replacing_insert_json_src
